page.overview:
What is Shadow Animatronics?

The Shadow animatronics are ghost-like entities with an unknown place of origin, whereabouts, and history functions. Shadow Freddy and RWQFSFASXC are the only two recurring animatronics from throughout the series.

The Shadow animatronics debuted in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as Easter egg characters. They later appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 3, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, Ultimate Custom Night, Help Wanted, Special Delivery, and Security Breach as minor characters/antagonists. They've also appeared in the Fazbear Frights and the film series. The Fazbear Fanverse also feature their own iterations of the Shadows, those being in Five Nights at Candy's and One Night at Flumpty's.

The Shadow animatronics lack solid forms as they appear as shadowy, supernatural specters with forms based on the Fazbear Entertainment animatronics. Most of them have very dark colors, while sporting glowing white eyes and teeth.

A Shadow counterpart based on Toy Bonnie. He first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's 2, where he spawns inside the office.
